title: Illegal instruction on EMR + Windows
body:
# Summary
OneDNN seems to be emitting an illegal instruction (bf16/amx)
Fails in CI (wasmtime -> openvino-rs -> openvino -> onednn)

# Version
(https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/oneDNN/commit/5baba714e16e11309774a62783f363cad30e97c7)

# Environment
CPU make and model - INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C
OS version - Windows 2025 server

# Steps to reproduce
